channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro perde gordura junto ao eleitorado conservador
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro has lost significant support among conservative voters, particularly among the wealthy, those identifying with center-right politics, and young voters from the Lava Jato generation, following revelations about his ties to Daniel Vorcaro. This decline reflects a weakening of his traditionally solid anti-PT base in high-income, liberal-conservative niches.

item.title: Polícia do Senado pede apuração de plano de atentado de Deolane contra Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The Senate Legislative Police filed an occurrence report to investigate statements by funk artist MC Misa, who accused influencer Deolane Bezerra of plotting an attack against Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a 2026 presidential candidate. The claims were made in an interview on the Frank Clips TikTok and YouTube channel, with the video attached to the report. Police are requesting a preliminary verification of the information’s credibility, noting the statements are the interviewee’s responsibility.

item.title: STF AO VIVO – Improbidade administrativa e Justiça gratuita – sessão de 28/5/2026
item.description: The STF is reviewing several actions challenging the Administrative Improbity Law, including provisions requiring intent (dolo) for wrongdoing, reducing penalties and prescription periods. Also on the agenda are ADIs filed by CSPM, Conamp, and PSB, plus RE 656558 on whether a mayor’s dispensing of bidding for legal hiring constitutes improbity, and ADC 80 assessing whether self-declaration of poverty suffices for free justice in labor courts post-2017 labor reform.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro não registrou missão oficial com ônus para viagem aos EUA, diz Senado
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro traveled to the U.S. from May 24–28 without filing an official mission request with Senate expenses, as required only when costs are covered by the Chamber. He met with Donald Trump, J.D. Vance, and Marco Rubio, stating the meetings aimed to advocate for labeling PCC and CV as terrorist groups and to showcase international backing for his presidential bid. The Lula government viewed the trip as an effort to divert attention from the Banco Master scandal, tied to alleged money requests from financier Daniel Vorcaro for the 'Dark Horse' film.

item.title: União entre Caiado e Zema esbarra no ‘radicalismo’ do Novo e na ‘neutralidade’ do PSD
item.description: A potential alliance between Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) and Romeu Zema (Novo) for the 2026 elections faces significant obstacles despite the potential to sum voter intentions and oppose Lula. Key challenges include determining the head of the ticket, as both are technically tied in polls (3%-5%), and ideological conflicts: Novo seeks to maintain its identity as antipetist right-wing and survive programmatically, while PSD aims to grow without definitively aligning with either PT or PL, making the alliance unnatural given their contradictory strategies.

item.title: O que acontece se Trump declarar PCC e CV terroristas, como quer Flávio Bolsonaro?
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro urged Donald Trump to designate the PCC and CV as terrorist organizations, which could enable the U.S. to deploy legal, financial, and diplomatic tools to pressure Brazil. Experts warn that even the mere possibility of such a move could create instability and weaken Lula’s government. While Trump has applied similar logic to Mexican cartels, scholars note that PCC and CV are profit-driven criminal gangs, not ideologically motivated terrorist groups.

item.title: Petrobras anuncia reajuste nos preços da gasolina após subsídio
item.description: Petrobras announced a R$0.48 per liter increase in gasoline A for distributors starting May 29, 2026, accompanied by a R$0.44 per liter government subsidy, resulting in a net increase of R$0.04 per liter (1.5%). For consumers, the impact will be R$0.03 per liter on gasoline C sold at pumps.

item.title: La reforma que permite anular elecciones por “injerencia extranjera” avanza en el Congreso entre alertas de la oposición
item.description: Mexico’s Chamber of Deputies approved a constitutional reform allowing election annulments in cases of proven foreign interference, with 307 votes in favor, 128 against, and one abstention. The ruling coalition defends the change as a shield against external threats, while the opposition warns it lacks thorough analysis and could be applied arbitrarily. The reform now awaits Senate approval in the coming hours.

item.title: Lula realiza 4ª aplicação de radioterapia preventiva
item.description: President Lula underwent his fourth session of preventive superficial radiotherapy at Sírio-Libanês Hospital in Brasília following the removal of a basal cell carcinoma from his scalp in April. The treatment protocol consists of 15 applications over three weeks, administered Monday through Friday according to his presidential schedule, with each session lasting approximately two minutes. Lula resumes normal duties at the Palácio do Planalto after each procedure.

item.title: Lula vende terreno na Lua para o trabalhador
item.description: The text criticizes the approval of the PEC to end the 6×1 work scale in the Chamber of Deputies, arguing that despite claims of improving workers' lives, the measure will likely worsen their conditions. The author claims the PEC's authors lack solid foundations and that the proposal serves interests contrary to those of workers. The title 'Lula sells lunar land to the worker' is used ironically to highlight the falseness of the promise.

item.title: Alcolumbre acelera PEC da oposição e impõe risco à tramitação do fim da 6×1 no Senado
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre accelerated the processing of an alternative PEC to the proposal ending the 6×1 work schedule, sending it directly to the Constitution and Justice Committee (CCJ) just hours after it was filed by the opposition. The initiative, led by Rogério Marinho (PL-RN), proposes a work-hour-based hiring model and expands direct negotiation between employers and employees, reacting to the Chamber-approved PEC that reduces the weekly workweek from 44 to 40 hours. The move comes amid a dispute over the pace of the main PEC’s review, with Alcolumbre avoiding commitment to an accelerated process, despite not indicating intent to block it.

item.title: Petrobras reajusta preço de gasolina na refinaria a partir desta sexta-feira
item.description: Petrobras raised the refinery gasoline price by R$ 0,48 per liter effective this Friday, but applied a R$ 0,44 per liter discount due to a government subsidy, resulting in a net increase of R$ 0,04 per liter (from R$ 2,57 to R$ 2,61). Despite the increase, the gap relative to international prices remains high at 55%, according to Abicom. The subsidy is estimated to cost public finances R$ 1,2 billion per month.

item.title: Lula passa por quarta sessão de radioterapia após retirada de câncer de pele
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva underwent his fourth session of preventive radiotherapy at the Sírio-Libanês Hospital in Brasília, following the surgical removal of a basal cell carcinoma from his scalp in April. The treatment consists of 15 sessions over three weeks, administered Monday to Friday, and does not interfere with his official duties, according to government officials. The lesion was diagnosed as low-aggressiveness, and his medical care continues under the supervision of cardiologist Roberto Kalil Filho and Dr. Ana Helena Germoglio.

item.title: Chanceler de Lula x Flávio: um lutou nove meses por reunião com Rubio, outro ganha encaixe
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) secured last-minute meetings with U.S. Vice President J.D. Vance and Secretary of State Marco Rubio in Washington following a meeting with Donald Trump. This contrasts with Chancellor Mauro Vieira, who took nine months to meet Rubio in January 2025, in a brief encounter on the sidelines of the G7. Flávio also expressed support for designating PCC and Comando Vermelho as foreign terrorist organizations by the U.S., a position opposed by Lula.

item.title: STF rejeita de uma vez 7 recursos de ex-assessor de Moraes
item.description: The Supreme Federal Court unanimously rejected seven appeals filed by Eduardo Tagliaferro, former aide to Minister Alexandre de Moraes, who is accused of breaching functional secrecy, exerting pressure during legal proceedings, obstructing investigations, and attempting to violently abolish the democratic rule of law. The virtual plenary vote, with Moraes, Zanin, Dino, and Cármen Lúcia in favor, leaves the case poised for a final ruling on conviction or acquittal.

item.title: Os acordos que Lula deve assinar em encontro com presidente do Suriname
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva is set to sign agreements with Suriname’s President Jennifer Geerlings-Simons to combat organized crime at the border and enhance environmental cooperation. The meeting at the Palácio do Planalto will also cover trade, Amazon security, logistical integration, agribusiness, oil, social programs, and infrastructure.

item.title: As pesquisas não mentem sobre Flávio
item.description: The first opinion poll capturing the impact of messages exchanged between Flávio Bolsonaro and Daniel Vorcaro was met with convenient skepticism by Bolsonaro supporters, who attacked the results after months of rising voting intentions for Bolsonaro’s eldest son. Despite prior optimism, allies of the former president began questioning the poll’s legitimacy, suggesting the data did not reflect electoral reality due to the scandal involving the senator.

item.title: Como votariam católicos e evangélicos no 2º turno, de acordo com pesquisa Ideia
item.description: According to a poll by Ideia Institute, in the 2026 presidential runoff, Lula would defeat Flávio Bolsonaro among Catholic voters with 56.7% to 31.8%, while Flávio would lead among evangelicals with 66.6% to 22.9% for Lula. Overall, without religious breakdown, Lula has 46.5% and Flávio 41.4%. The survey interviewed 1,500 people between May 23 and 27, 2026, with a margin of error of 2.5 percentage points.

item.title: Crusoé: A primeira pesquisa de Aécio como pré-candidato a presidente
item.description: The Meio/Ideia poll released on April 28 shows President Lula (PT) with 46% voting intention against federal deputy Aécio Neves (PSDB-MG) with 25% in a hypothetical runoff scenario for the 2026 presidential election. Blank and null votes totaled 29%. Aécio is being evaluated by the PSDB as a potential pre-candidate for president.

item.title: Temu é multada em US$ 232 milhões pela UE por venda de brinquedos e carregadores inseguros
item.description: Temu was fined $232 million by the European Union for selling unsafe baby toys and faulty chargers, violating the EU's Digital Services Act. This is the second-largest fine under the DSA, following the penalty imposed on Elon Musk's X in late 2025. In Brazil, the Lula government is accelerating measures such as ending the 'blusinha tax', expanding Desenrola 2.0, and providing credit to app-based drivers, aiming to influence voter sentiment ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Claudio Castro está morto politicamente e precisa entender isso, dizem aliados no PL
item.description: Cláudio Castro, former Rio de Janeiro governor and PL Senate candidate, has been declared 'politically dead' by allies after revelations of his meeting with banker Daniel Vorcaro in New York, where he was served whiskey at a $1 million event. Federal Police investigations link this meeting to multimillion-dollar investments by RioPrevidência in Banco Master, worsening his legal and political standing. The PL is pushing for his quick withdrawal so Bolsonaro can name a replacement, aiming to win both Senate seats in Rio to strengthen its bloc and enable impeachment of STF ministers like Alexandre de Moraes.

item.title: Deputado do PT, Rogério Correia é condenado a indenizar Bolsonaro em R$ 20 mil por manipular foto com IA
item.description: Federal Deputy Rogério Correia (PT-MG) was sentenced by Brasília's 7th Civil Court to pay R$20,000 in moral damages to former President Jair Bolsonaro for publishing an AI-generated image falsely linking Bolsonaro to the Banco Master scandal. The judge ruled that while freedom of expression protects harsh opinions, distributing a realistic fabrication that simulates a nonexistent event exceeds those bounds and risks misleading the public. Correia must also issue a public retraction on his official profile.

item.title: JOTA Principal: Câmara aprova PEC do fim da escala 6×1 com acordo de Motta e governo Lula
item.description: The Chamber approved in two rounds the PEC ending the 6×1 work scale, reducing the weekly workload to 40 hours in two phases, with 472 favorable and 22 opposed votes in the first round and 461 favorable and 19 opposed in the second. The agreement between Hugo Motta and the Lula government includes the future approval of a MEI and Simples revenue cap adjustment as a counterpart. The PL attempted to block the proposal but was isolated after shifting its stance and proposing a more radical reduction, while the issue gains momentum as a key electoral priority for the government.

item.title: Pesquisa indica onde Flávio Bolsonaro perdeu mais votos
item.description: The Meio/Ideia poll shows that Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) lost more votes in a potential runoff against Lula (PT) among young voters, center-right supporters, and those earning over five minimum wages, following the leak of messages from the senator to banker Daniel Vorcaro, former controller of Banco Master. The decline in support was concentrated in these groups, reflecting the negative impact of the scandal on his image.

item.title: Revogar taxa das blusinhas é acerto para 66%, diz pesquisa
item.description: The revocation of the 'blusinhas' tax was viewed as a correct decision by 66% of respondents in the May 2026 Latam Pulse survey by AtlasIntel/Bloomberg, with 23% calling it a mistake and 12% unsure. This contrasts with March, when the tax was seen as the government's biggest error by 62%. Other highly approved policies include free medication access (83% approval) and income tax exemption for those earning up to R$5,000 monthly (81% approval).

item.title: A melhora na avaliação do governo Lula, segundo a pesquisa Meio/Ideia
item.description: The Meio/Ideia poll released on May 28, 2026 shows an improvement in public evaluation of President Lula's government compared to April. While 12.2% rated the government as 'excellent' and 23.4% as 'good', the share rating it as 'terrible' dropped from 32.3% in April to 25.4%. Approval of Lula's performance rose from 44% to 46.6%, while disapproval fell from 53% to 51.4%, based on a survey of 1,500 voters with a 2.5-point margin of error.

item.title: Ricardo Couto: 'minha ideia era fazer uma transição sem tocar no governo, mas o estado não pode ficar parado'
item.description: Rio de Janeiro's interim governor, Judge Ricardo Couto, stated that his original plan was to merely oversee a transition until the next governor's election, without interfering in the government. However, due to the delay in the STF's decision on his continued tenure, he argued that the state cannot remain stagnant and has acted to maintain governance. His future in office depends on a ruling from the Supreme Federal Court.

item.title: Ministro Mauro Vieira vai à China neste domingo
item.description: Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira will visit China from May 31 to June 2, 2026, to attend the 5th edition of the Brazil-China Strategic Dialogue (DEG) in Beijing, where he will meet with Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi. The meeting aims to strengthen bilateral cooperation in tourism, culture, and infrastructure investments. This will be Vieira's second visit to Beijing, following his accompaniment of President Lula on a state visit in May 2025.

item.title: Congresso avança rumo ao fim da escala 6x1
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies approved in two rounds a Constitutional Amendment Proposal (PEC) to reduce the weekly workweek and guarantee workers two days of rest, celebrated as a victory for President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. The approval comes less than five months ahead of the 2026 elections, and the text now moves to the Senate for further review.

item.title: Câmara atropela a 6x1 e joga ao Senado a chance de ser o 'inimigo do povo'
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies approved a proposal to reduce the workweek from 6x1 to 4x1 with overwhelming support: 472 in favor and 22 against in the first round, and 461 to 19 in the second. Dubbed the 'miracle of the Electronic Ballot Box' by supporters, the bill now moves to the Senate, where it may face stronger opposition. The measure is seen as a labor advancement but also as a challenge to balancing productivity with social rights.

item.title: Eleições e escândalo do Banco Master impulsionam voto pelo fim da jornada 6x1 no Brasil
item.description: The Banco Master scandal and public pressure are driving support for reducing the 6x1 workweek in Brazil. A Constitutional Amendment Proposal was approved in the Chamber of Deputies, with only 22 opposing votes in the first round and 19 in the second, indicating broad parliamentary consensus. Lawmakers are being pressured on the streets and social media to act on demands for better working conditions.

item.title: A 1ª grande vitória do balconista de farmácia que lançou movimento pelo fim da escala 6x1 com desabafo no TikTok
item.description: Pharmacy clerk Rick Azevedo became a national symbol of the fight for reduced working hours after his TikTok rant against the 6x1 work schedule went viral in 2023. His video inspired a petition with over 3 million signatures, led to the founding of the Vida Além do Trabalho (VAT) movement, and culminated in his election as the most-voted PSOL councilor in Rio de Janeiro. Public pressure resulted in the Chamber of Deputies approving, on May 27, a bill to reduce the weekly workweek from 44 to 40 hours, replacing the 6x1 model with five workdays and two paid days off.

item.title: Lula recebe presidente do Suriname para fechar 12 acordos
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva will receive Suriname’s President Jennifer Geerlings-Simons to sign up to 12 bilateral agreements focused on Amazon integration, organized crime combat, infrastructure, and energy cooperation, particularly regarding Suriname’s oil discoveries. The visit centers on four pillars: oil, connectivity and infrastructure, social programs, and agribusiness, with emphasis on police and military cooperation in the border region between Pará, Amapá, and Suriname.

item.title: Zema tenso com o contra-ataque do STF
item.description: Romeu Zema, governor of Minas Gerais and potential presidential candidate for the Novo party, faces internal pressure from his own party, which threatens to withdraw support for his candidacy, along with growing concern over recent Supreme Federal Court (STF) rulings that could impact his political agenda.

item.title: A campanha de Flávio morreu? Especialistas em opinião pública acreditam que não
item.description: Public opinion experts state that Flávio Bolsonaro's pre-candidacy is not over, despite controversies surrounding his relationship with Daniel Vorcaro. They argue the damage so far is limited, reversible, and likely to cause only a 3-4 point drop in polls — within the margin of error — without undermining his loyal voter base.

item.title: As novas modalidades de abuso de poder em resoluções do TSE
item.description: The TSE has been expanding its regulatory power through electoral resolutions, creating new forms of abuse of power, particularly concerning disinformation about the electoral process. Resolution 23.735/2024, which systematized electoral offenses separately from propaganda, innovated not only by maintaining severe sanctions like cassation and ineligibility but also by introducing new illicit figures, such as abuse of power through disinformation about the electoral process, thereby expanding punitive reach beyond mere content removal or fines.

item.title: Governistas comemoram aprovação do fim da 6 X 1 e provocam PL
item.description: Government supporters celebrated the approval of the end of the 6×1 work scale in the Chamber of Deputies, with a PEC establishing a 40-hour weekly cap, two paid days off, and a 14-month transition, negotiated by Hugo Motta, Leo Prates, and backed by Lula. Government leaders such as Paulo Pimenta, Lindbergh Farias, and Marcelo Freixo hailed it as a historic victory for workers, while Fernando Haddad accused the PL of attempting to block the measure. The PEC now moves to the Senate for review.

item.title: PF pediu operação um dia após Kassio pedir vista de julgamento de Cláudio Castro no TSE
item.description: The Federal Police (PF) requested authorization from the Supreme Federal Court (STF) on March 11 to conduct an operation against former Rio de Janeiro governor Cláudio Castro (PL) in the Master case. The request came one day after Justice Kassio Nunes Marques requested a pause (vista) in the TSE trial that could have removed Castro from office. The operation was carried out last Tuesday (26), over two months after the initial request.

item.title: Podcast analisa o saldo e os significados do encontro de Flávio Bolsonaro e Trump
item.description: The meeting between Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Donald Trump was marked by the former U.S. president's silence, as he made no public comments about the gathering — a departure from his usual public remarks with foreign candidates. Details of the Tuesday (26) meeting came solely from allies of the Brazilian senator.

item.title: O fator Trump
item.description: The meeting between Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and former U.S. President Donald Trump sparked political reactions, particularly from the Workers’ Party (PT), which questioned the authenticity of the White House photo. Though not a decisive event, the encounter boosts Flávio Bolsonaro’s visibility in the 2026 electoral race, keeping him in the campaign spotlight. The article emphasizes that access to Trump is a strategic advantage, even if not fundamental.

item.title: Eleições 2026: Lula volta de viagem ao Amazonas sem garantia de aliado do PT em palanque local
item.description: Lula concluded his Amazonas visit with billion-dollar investment announcements but failed to secure a unified major ticket with the local PT. Former federal deputy Marcelo Ramos was officially named the PT’s Senate pre-candidate, but key allies Senator Omar Aziz (PSD) and Eduardo Braga (MDB) did not discuss Ramos’ inclusion with Lula, stressing that alliances are built, not imposed. Despite the impasse, Ramos insists his candidacy remains intact and the matter is 'settled' for the PT.

item.title: Diálogo com Alcolumbre, força de Motta na Câmara e ministros de Lula no plenário: os bastidores da aprovação do fim da escala 6x1
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies approved in first round a constitutional amendment (PEC) reducing the workweek from 44 to 40 hours within up to 14 months, allowing the end of the 6x1 scale, with 472 votes in favor and 22 against. The approval involved negotiations between Chamber President Arthur Lira and Senator Davi Alcolumbre, supported by Lula’s ministers in the plenary, highlighting Motta’s political strength in advancing the agenda.

item.title: Por que Lula não convence a Roberta e o que isso diz sobre 2026
item.description: Roberta, a supermarket cashier in Osasco earning two minimum wages, did not vote for Lula in 2022 and will not in 2026, despite positive macroeconomic indicators. Her belief that the economy worsened stems from the pressure of living costs — rent, gas, credit card debt, and informality — that consume her income even as the minimum wage rises in real terms. For her, the economy and the government are one and the same: a shrinking life produces no gratitude, even with rising graphs in Brasília.

item.title: Lula chama de conquista histórica aprovação na Câmara da PEC que acaba com escala 6x1
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva praised the approval in the Chamber of Deputies of the PEC ending the 6x1 work schedule as a historic and civilizatory achievement, emphasizing progress in reducing the weekly workweek from 44 to 40 hours.

item.title: Votação do fim da 6x1 é marcada por cantoria, provocações e pastor defendendo mais tempo para sexo
item.description: The Chamber approved the PEC ending the 6x1 work schedule amid chants, provocations, and boos, with a pastor advocating for more time for sex during the debate. The proposal is a key part of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva’s (PT) re-election campaign for 2026.

item.title: Lula recebe presidente do Suriname nesta quinta e deve assinar acordo de combate ao crime organizado na fronteira
item.description: Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva will meet with Suriname's President Jennifer Geerlings-Simons in Brasília to sign agreements on combating organized crime at the border and environmental cooperation. The meeting will cover Amazon security, logistical integration, trade relations, oil, connectivity, social programs, and agribusiness, with emphasis on forest preservation and tackling transnational crimes such as illegal mining and drug trafficking.

item.title: Fim da escala 6x1: depois de aprovada na Câmara, PEC segue para o Senado, onde deve encontrar resistências; veja detalhes do texto
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies approved in two rounds a PEC reducing the workweek from 44 to 40 hours, allowing the end of the 6x1 scale. The proposal now moves to the Senate, where it is expected to face resistance due to deliberate pacing and the parliamentary recess, though allies of Senate President Davi Alcolumbre suggest approval before the 2026 elections. The text amends the Constitution to set a maximum daily workday of eight hours and weekly workload of 40 hours, with exceptions via collective bargaining agreements.

item.title: Veja imagens de deputados comemorando o fim da escala 6 X 1
item.description: Left-wing deputies and government allies celebrated in the Chamber the approval in two rounds of the PEC changing the work schedule from 6x1 to 5x2, reducing the weekly workload from 44 to 40 hours. The vote was marked by chants of 'olê, olê, olê, olá, Lula, Lula' and the samba 'Vou Festejar' by Beth Carvalho, with unionists and workers present in the gallery. President Lula and Chamber President Hugo Motta endorsed the measure, which now moves to the Senate.

item.title: O encontro entre Flávio e Trump e os interesses americanos na eleição brasileira - O Assunto #1729
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro met with Donald Trump at the White House on May 26, 2026, securing a symbolic photo and urging the U.S. to designate Brazilian criminal factions as terrorist organizations. The meeting followed controversies over his talks with Daniel Vorcaro and the 'Dark Horse' case, aiming to shift focus from scandal. Analyst Oliver Stuenkel notes U.S. interests in Brazil’s October elections center on security and ideological alignment with the right.

item.title: Michelle aciona STF contra Janones por ligá-la ao caso Master
item.description: Former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro (PL) filed a criminal complaint with the STF against federal deputy André Janones (Rede-MG) for slander, defamation, and insult after he linked her to alleged funds received from Banco Master tied to the Bolsonaro family. Her lawyers argue the statements exceed parliamentary immunity and constitute personal offenses, seeking a minimum of 20,000 euros in moral damages.
